posts.name: trudge
posts.cooked:
So, the Greatest Legacy promo card got me wondering: which of the heroes were around during WW2 in some form, and could there be scenarios involving their battles?

 

It seems like there was a version of Bunker running around during WW2 (based on a card in the Time Cataclysm environement).  Haka would have been alive during this time.  The Argent Adept wouldn't have been alive yet, but there was likely some sort of Virtuoso of the Void.  Am I missing anyone?  Just how old is the Scholar?

 

What villains would have been around?  Akosh'bhuta and Gloomweaver would both be around.  So's Apostate, but I get the impression that he won't appear until after Fanatic does.  What if the Matriarch wasn't the first person to wear that mask?  Chairman Pike was alive at the time, but probably not directly involved...

posts.name: Ironic
posts.cooked:
Blade sr. might have been involved, as a young man... or perhaps even his father.  La Capitan can show up anywhen - indeed, she seems to have recruited Chip from around that time.  (And, of course, other could use time travel, too, if needed.)  The first big boom of UFO sighting happened during the war - what if Voss (a precocious young genetically-engineer juggernaught at age twelve) staged an invasion, but was beaten back and went to harrass another galaxy for a few decades to gain strength?

On the hero side, there are the time-travellers, again, Legacy, Bunker, Scholar, Haka and not-Adept seem like the only really logical calls thusfar.

For environments, Megalopolis still works fine in the past, Atlantis was still ruined, Insula Primalis has hardly changed in millions of years (40s heroes loved "lost world"settings even more than modern ones, really), Rook City mostly works, there's no exact date on when Anubis returned, and the Realm of Dischord is eternal.  And, yet again, don't rule out time travel.

I really like the idea for time-appropriate promos, here.  And maybe a "Beaches Of Normandy" or "Meapolis World's Fair, 1939" environment deck.
